Choose Disha for career astrology, Pragati for professional resume writing, or Siddhi to combine both services—according to your individual requirements.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions.

What is career astrology consultation?

Disha uses traditional astrological interpretations to explore career-related questions. It offers a reflective perspective, not a guaranteed prediction or evidence-based assessment of job outcomes.

What is included in the combined package?

Siddhi (₹5,000) combines Disha career astrology consultation and Pragati professional resume writing. Contact Mr. Gowtham to confirm the process and requirements.

Who can request resume writing?

Students, recent graduates and experienced professionals can enquire about resume writing. The final scope will depend on the individual's background and requirements.

How do I book a service?

Use the relevant WhatsApp button to contact Mr. Gowtham. You can discuss your requirements, availability, service process and payment arrangements directly.

Are job placements guaranteed?

No. Astrology consultation and resume writing cannot guarantee a job, interview, promotion or salary increase.

Is payment available directly through the website?

Contact Mr. Gowtham to confirm the available payment methods and next steps. This website does not process payments directly.

MEET YOUR ADVISOR

Corporate Experience Meets Career-Focused Insight.

Mr. S. Gowtham · Career Insights & Strategy

Years — Corporate Sales & Marketing
Years — Astrology Consultation

Mr. S. Gowtham brings 13 years of corporate experience in sales and marketing across the FMCG and consumer durables sectors. His professional background provides a practical perspective on business environments, workplace expectations and professional communication.

Alongside his corporate career, he has spent six years in astrology consultation, drawing on teachings from Sristi Jothidam, an astrology practice with more than three decades of experience.

Through Tatwamasi, he offers career-focused astrological consultations and professional resume writing—connecting reflective insights with the practical task of presenting career experience effectively.

His approach centres on listening to career-related questions, understanding a client’s professional background and tailoring each service to the agreed requirements.
